t: Neuromorphic Computer: Synaptic Energy Desk — Simple
name: Neuromorphic Computer: Synaptic Energy Desk — Simple
title: Neuromorphic Computer: Synaptic Energy Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Synapses sip energy: the desk computes the energy per synaptic operation from the hardware's picojoules-per-SOP and the network's activity. A million neurons at 10 Hz with 1000 synapses each is 10^12 SOP/s — the power follows.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Power: 1e12 SOP/s at 10 pJ each = 10.0 W. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Neuromorphic Computer: Synaptic Fluctuation vs. Fixed Activation Threshold
real_world_basis: SOP-rate power math is the real basis of neuromorphic engineering.
signature_version: Signature version: the fixed-threshold energy desk — the chapter's Fixed Activation Threshold as the efficiency target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the activity factor dominates — measure yours, don't assume 10%.
math_note: Power: 1e12 SOP/s at 10 pJ each: 10.0 W [verified]; Landauer floor per SOP at 300 K: 2.87 zJ [verified]

math_check.label: Landauer floor per SOP at 300 K

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a power quoted at 1% activity for a 50% workload.
how_it_works: Multiply the SOP rate by the energy per SOP for the power. The demo budgets an inference chip.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
